title: TinySocs Windows Event Log Document
description: Schema for documents indexed into tinysocs-winlog-* indices. Each document represents a single Windows event log entry collected by the TinySocs Agent.

@timestamp.description: UTC timestamp of the event in ISO 8601 format.

message.description: Human-readable formatted event description. May be truncated per privacy.truncate_fields config.

id.description: Numeric Windows event ID (e.g., 4624 for logon, 4625 for logon failure).

level.description: Event severity level as reported by Windows.

provider.description: Name of the Windows event provider (e.g., 'Microsoft-Windows-Security-Auditing').

record_id.description: Windows event record ID (monotonically increasing per channel).

computer_name.description: FQDN or hostname of the machine that generated the event.

event_id.description: String representation of the event ID (for keyword-based queries).

provider_name.description: Provider name from the Windows event XML.

event_data.description: Dynamic key-value pairs extracted from the Windows event XML EventData element. Contents vary by event ID and provider. Fields listed in privacy.drop_fields will be absent; fields in privacy.hash_fields will contain SHA-256 hashes.
